answer: The river holds work receipts rather than names, so the summit of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the garden of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
